static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, no close family nearby
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to, but comparing has affected friendships; has not yet revealed feelings of inferiority to friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar psychological issues have emerged before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logicality, able to describe emotions and distress; high cooperation, positive attitude; tends toward self-criticism and comparison with others

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling inferior and Self-doubt from comparing with others while running; these feelings started after joining a local running group and gradually developed into constant comparison while running, reducing the joy of running and affecting mood, self-esteem, and motivation throughout the day.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to regain enjoyment of running and improve overall mood and motivation; hoping to Learning to identify and challenge negative thoughts about my abilities, find a more balanced perspective, and rebuild confidence.
growth_experiences: After joining a local running group six months ago, began frequently comparing myself with others during group runs; seeing others run better, the thought 'I am not good enough' arose, gradually weakening interest and satisfaction in running and extending this comparison to friendships and career/entrepreneurial goals.

core_beliefs: Only being better than others gives one value

special_situations.event: When running with others in a running group, seeing other members run better
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others run better than me, it means I am not capable / I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trains harder, sets personal records to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never outperform them, I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Running in front of others, feeling watched and worried about judgment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform averagely, others will look down on me / think I am overreacting
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids expressing vulnerability to friends, keeping silent to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible and are laughing at me

special_situations.event: Reviews recent training where he has increased his running distance to 5 miles
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching the top level counts as achievement; one's own progress is not worth affirming
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays one's own progress, continuing self-criticism to promote improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This little progress is nothing; still not good enough

special_situations.event: After seeing others faster while running, associating it with one's own future performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as others now, I will never reach their level in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gives oneself more pressure, forces higher goals to avoid the feeling of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be able to run as well as them

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized; to maintain self-worth in the group and enjoy running
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged, looked down upon, and Being rejected; worrying about feeling ashamed after exposing vulnerability
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by working harder to pursue results and perfection
Reducing self-disclosure and help-seeking to avoid possible negation and humiliation

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, someone easily compared and belittled

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests sharing feelings with friends in moderation and testing the support system
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I express vulnerability, others will think I am melodramatic or look down on me (fearing being Being rejected / judged)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond in a brief, objective tone, avoiding details, saying 'no need to bother others', and quickly shifting to training plans or data.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor affirms her achievement of increasing running distance to 5 miles
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Praise may not be genuine or sufficient to prove one is not bad; avoiding having shortcomings seen through
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying and belittling one's own progress, using expressions like 'this is nothing' and 'anyone can do it', in a flat tone.

manifestations: Fearing judgment and not revealing vulnerability to friends, feeling like carrying the pressure alone
In group activities (running), feels self-worth threatened, intensifying the isolation experience
Running was originally a beloved hobby and 'escape', but constant comparison has taken away the joy
Personal growth and goals (like entrepreneurial dreams) eroded by Self-doubt
outcomes: Declining interest and satisfaction, Reduced drive
Reduced investment and action toward life goals

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Not expressing inferiority and stress to friends, bottling up emotions
Training harder to cope with shame and unease

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Strict demands on oneself, often defines self-worth by comparing with others
Worries about being seen as 'overreacting' and suppresses self-expression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assumes others will judge one as bad or pretentious
Projecting inner Self-denial onto others' assumed evaluations during group runs

positive_force: Has a stable interest in running and can persist in training (has raised mileage to 5 miles)
Actively seeks help and is highly cooperative, willing to try cognitive restructuring and reality testing
Clear life goal (wants to support the dream of opening a restaurant through a second job)
Able to notice and describe his own negative thinking and its scope of influence
negative_force: Strong tendency toward social comparison (dependence on external validation), self-worth bound to others' performance
Negating positive evidence and achievements, ignoring one's own progress
Fear of being judged and shamed; reduces self-exposure and access to social support
Excessive self-pressure, leading to Loss of pleasure, Low mood, and Decreased drive

target_behavior.behavior: Constantly comparing and Self-denial when running with others, accompanied by Anxiety / low mood and Loss of pleasure
antecedent: Joins group running activities, runs in front of others
Seeing others' pace or endurance surpass one's own
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am not good enough' and dependence on external evaluation, worrying about being seen as inadequate in others' eyes
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being negated (escaping shame) through self-criticism and pressure, and trying to Gain recognition
target_behavior.consequence: Declining running enjoyment, persistent inferiority and Low mood, affecting daily mood, Interpersonal relationships, and motivation toward entrepreneurial goals

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing vulnerability to friends and seeking support
antecedent: Thinking others may judge oneself as 'overreacting' or 'not good enough'
When talking about inferiority or failure
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing that exposing vulnerability leads to being Being rejected or ashamed; inner object relations represent others as judges
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and shame experiences, maintaining surface-level security
target_behavior.consequence: Increased sense of Loneliness, Reduced social support, negative emotions and beliefs maintained
